name: Found Light
desc:
⚠️ WARNING: this game has jumpscares, scary sounds, etc.
💀To enjoy the game, play with headphones.



You find yourself in a room where your survival depends on a single action—pressing the button when it turns green. But be careful: if you're too slow or press the red button by mistake, it will cost you your life. To make things even harder, the game will distract you with sudden jump scares, eerie sounds, and other unexpected effects. Can you handle the pressure and survive?
